904.speaker: Narrator

910.speaker: Narrator
910.text: "As a reminder, we are in need of new allies after the loss of our GRACE membership, and we can ill afford to antagonize our new neighbors."

914.speaker: Narrator
914.text: "Rumburg has not acknowledged the new republic so far, though they are rumored to be sending financial support to it."

915.speaker: Narrator
915.text: "Rumburg was the first nation to acknowledge the new republic, and are rumored to be sending financial support to it."

919.speaker: Narrator
919.text: "Our permanent transfer of the territory was met by limited protests from Rizians living there, which were swiftly quelled."

923.speaker: Narrator
923.text: "However, Wehlen has pledged to respect the terms of the amended Zille Agreement. Barring no further surprises, we can expect an eventual normalizing of relations."

927.speaker: Narrator
927.text: "Our lack of diplomatic ties with Wehlen means those families who were separated by the Zille transfer will not be reunited anytime soon."

928.speaker: Narrator
928.text: "As hostilities between Rumburg and Sordland become an inevitability, it remains to be seen whether Zilleans, along with the rest of Wehlen, are drawn into the fray."

929.speaker: Narrator
929.text: "Naturally, Derdia was the first to acknowledge this new republic, and is rumored to be sending funding to it."

933.speaker: Narrator
933.text: "For the time being, it appears that Derdia has been holding the leadership back from directly challenging Rizia's borders."

937.speaker: Narrator
937.text: I wondered if there was anything I could do to foster goodwill among the Palesians.
